text: You're looking for a vegan dish that's high in protein and can be prepared within 45 minutes. This Tibetan Greens With Tofu recipe fits your requirements perfectly. The dish features firm tofu as the main protein source, which should help you meet your health goal. Additionally, the recipe includes green peas, which are a good source of protein as well. The preparation time is also well within your time budget, making it a convenient option for you.
